sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and commodity leadership persists as Healthcare and Energy dominate momentum, while Consumer Defensive shows early signs of fatigue.

Market breadth remains narrow with only 3 of 11 sectors holding all-green status across all timeframes. Healthcare and Energy continue to command the top spots with sustained 1-, 3-, and 6-month outperformance, backed by robust momentum scores of 0.90 and 0.88, respectively. Technology holds rank 2 with a moderate 0.533 momentum score, while deep cyclical and growth pockets lag significantly.

Rotation is subdued across the board. Marginal 5-day rank improvements emerged in lower-ranked sectors like Consumer Cyclical (rank 10) and Real Estate (rank 7), while Communication Services hit absolute bottom with a 0.000 momentum score and an 11th-place rank. Meanwhile, Consumer Defensive is beginning to slip despite solid higher-timeframe metrics.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 3 of 11 groups are all-green across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD: Healthcare (0.90 momentum), Energy (0.88 momentum), and Consumer Defensive (0.75 momentum).
- **Sustained Leadership:** Healthcare and Energy are the sole sectors demonstrating sustained strength, placing in the top 3 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month trailing ranks.
- **Top Momentum Leaders:** Healthcare (0.900, rank 3), Energy (0.883, rank 1), and Consumer Defensive (0.750, rank 4) form the upper tier of momentum, with Technology trailing at 0.533 (rank 2).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Gainers:** Consumer Cyclical (+1 spot to rank 10, momentum 0.367), Real Estate (+1 spot to rank 7, momentum 0.450), and Healthcare (+1 spot to rank 3, momentum 0.900) posted the only rank gains over the last 5 sessions.
- **Top 5-Day Decliners:** Communication Services (-1 spot to rank 11, momentum 0.000), Financials (-1 spot to rank 8, momentum 0.433), and Consumer Defensive (-1 spot to rank 4, momentum 0.750) saw ranks deteriorate.
- **Momentum Laggards:** Communication Services sits at the bottom with 0.000 momentum (rank 11), followed by Industrials at 0.317 (rank 6) and Consumer Cyclical at 0.367 (rank 10).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Consumer Defensive displays an early-warning negative divergence, shedding 1 rank spot over the last 5 days despite maintaining an otherwise strong 0.75 momentum score and all-green status.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive healthcare, consumer staples, and traditional energy dominate sustained leadership, while tech and utility pockets face sharp short-term rank deterioration.

Market breadth remains selective, with 27 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green profiles across all timeframes. High-momentum leadership is heavily anchored in defensives and travel/energy, led by Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.928) and Oil & Gas Drilling (momentum 0.878). Sustained multi-month outperformance continues across groups like Tobacco, Oil & Gas Integrated, Lodging, and Household & Personal Products.

Concurrently, rotation is hitting cyclical tech and defensive utilities. Software - Application dropped 18 spots to rank 117, and Internet Content & Information plummeted 30 spots to rank 120 (momentum 0.100). Meanwhile, industrial and consumer cyclicals such as Engineering & Construction (+23 spots) and Restaurants (+16 spots) are demonstrating sharp short-term rank jumps off lower momentum bases.

## Strength
- **Breadth Leadership:** 27 of 144 groups are all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD timeframes, underpinned by Drug Manufacturers - General (momentum 0.93), Tobacco (0.87), REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.86), and Oil & Gas E&P (0.85).
- **Multi-Month Consistency:** Groups maintaining top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons include Health Information Services, Credit Services, Lodging, and Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries alongside large-cap pharmaceuticals and integrated oil.
- **Top Absolute Momentum:** Drug Manufacturers - General (0.928), Oil & Gas Drilling (0.878), Tobacco (0.872), and REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.865) sit at the top of overall momentum rankings.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest Gainers:** Engineering & Construction surged 23 spots to rank 59 (momentum 0.37), followed by Restaurants (+16 to rank 92, momentum 0.53) and Textile Manufacturing (+16 to rank 22, momentum 0.70).
- **Sharpest Declines:** Utilities - Regulated Water plunged 35 spots to rank 74 (momentum 0.42), Internet Content & Information lost 30 spots to rank 120 (momentum 0.10), and Education & Training Services dropped 28 spots to rank 115 (momentum 0.13).
- **Momentum Laggards:** Advertising Agencies holds the weakest profile in the market (momentum 0.023, rank 144 YTD), alongside Solar (0.093, rank 141 YTD) and Uranium (0.094, rank 132 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Biotechnology (momentum 0.66) fell 12 spots over 5 sessions, while Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.63) and Waste Management (momentum 0.65) each slipped 11 spots, signaling near-term exhaustion despite solid longer-term metrics.
- **Emerging Rank Jumps:** Engineering & Construction (momentum 0.37, +23 spots), Luxury Goods (momentum 0.39, +13 spots), and Residential Construction (momentum 0.45, +11 spots) are logging fast short-term improvements from depressed momentum baselines.
- **Fragile Leadership:** Marine Shipping displays an unstable all-green configuration, flagged by a low agreement score of 0.45.
